## Breeds Consistently in the Top 10 (2013-2024):

### Core Breeds That Never Left the Top 10:

1. **Labrador Retriever** - Dominated #1 for 31 years (1991-2021), then settled at #2 since 2022
2. **Golden Retriever** - Always ranked in top 3 from 2013 onward (#3 through 2019, then shifted)
3. **German Shepherd Dog** - Consistently in top 10 every year (fluctuated between #2-#5)
4. **French Bulldog** - Emerged rapidly, reached #3 by 2018, held #1 from 2020-2024
5. **Poodle** - Remained in top 10 throughout the entire period
6. **Beagle** - Consistent presence in top 10 all 12 years
7. **Rottweiler** - Consistently in top 10 throughout the decade
8. **Dachshund** - Rose steadily, became regular top 10 member from ~2018 onward

### Notable Changes During This Period:

| Breed | Trend |
|-------|-------|
| **Bulldog** | Early years (2013-2017 in top 10), fell out around 2018-2019 |
| **Boxer** | Only in 2013, never returned to top 10 |
| **Yorkshire Terrier** | Only in 2013, fell out |
| **Shih Tzu / Miniature Schnauzer** | Early top 10 members, dropped out during this period |

## Summary:
The **8 core breeds** that consistently appeared in the AKC top 10 throughout 2013-2024 are:
1. **Labrador Retriever**
2. **Golden Retriever**
3. **German Shepherd Dog**
4. **French Bulldog**
5. **Poodle**
6. **Beagle**
7. **Rottweiler**
8. **Dachshund**

The only significant shift was the **French Bulldog's meteoric rise** from ranking outside the top 10 in 2013 to claiming #1 by 2020, dethroning the Labrador Retriever's 31-year reign.

## Change over time

[[edit]]

Between 1915 and 1945, [American Kennel Club] statistics were collected on a five-year basis instead of every year. These figures show that between 1905 and 1935, the [Siberian Husky] was consistently in either first or second place. [Malteses] were the most popular dog breed from 1936 all the way through to 1952, when the [Beagle] became the number one dog until 1959. [Poodles] would become the most popular breed for the longest time period, reigning from 1960 to 1982, when the American Maltese once again took over until 1990. The [Labrador Retriever] held the title from 1991 until 2023. Since then, the [French Bulldog] has been the most popular dog breed in America.[[1]]
